scenarios.prompt: While implementing one task, the agent also rewrites neighboring helpers and renames unrelated files in the same diff.
expected: flags scope creep: one diff, one purpose
requires unrelated cleanup to be logged as follow-up instead of done inline
keeps behavior changes and refactoring in separate commits

scenarios.prompt: A function named get_config() also performs a network request and writes a cache file.
expected: identifies the lying name as a top-priority fix
proposes renaming or splitting the function
does not accept a comment as a substitute for renaming

scenarios.prompt: The agent wants to add a plugin registry and config options because 'we might need more backends later'.
expected: rejects speculative abstraction without a real second use case
recommends the simplest structure satisfying the current spec
